faq.intro: Question counts, durations, attempts and benefits differ between exams. See the detail page of the exam you choose.

attempts.answer: The number of attempts per purchase is shown on the card and on the detail page of each exam. While you still have attempts you can buy more; the extra attempts are added to the exam you already have in My exams.
attempts.question: How many attempts does one purchase give? How do I buy more?

formats.answer: A FULL exam has every section of the paper, taken one after another in one attempt. A section exam has a single section, for example HSA Mathematics and Data Processing. A subject exam is for exams organized by subject, such as SPT, SP2E and the high school graduation exam. The section or subject of each exam is shown on its card.
formats.question: How do FULL, section and subject exams differ?

otherAccount.answer: Rules about buying for another account are published by the operating unit. If you need help, contact support through the channels in the Need help? block below.
otherAccount.question: Can I buy for another account?

paidNoExam.answer: Keep your order code and contact support through the channels in the Need help? block below so we can look it up. Exams already granted to your account are in My exams.
paidNoExam.question: My payment succeeded but I cannot see the exam. What now?

refund.answer: Refunds follow the policy published by the operating unit. If you need help, contact support through the channels in the Need help? block below.
refund.question: When can I get a refund?

voucher.answer: Enter the code at the purchase confirmation step, before you go to payment. The system recalculates the price and shows the amount to pay before you confirm.
voucher.question: How do I use a discount code?
